text:
alex: quick sync 12 postmortem follow-ups consolidated here. i opened a single "lane" to track owners, ETA, and blockers. please confirm owners or reassign.

maya: thanks. can you paste the high priority list?

alex: sure. TL;DR:
1) scheduler policy tweak to prevent long-job preemption -> owner: ? -> eta: 10d
2) short-term quota backstop + automated revert -> owner: ? -> eta: 4d
3) predictive headroom alert + mitigation runbook -> owner: ? -> eta: 21d
4) burst node cap to reduce noisy-neighbor evictions -> owner: ? -> eta: 7d
5) request-shape sampler + routing experiment -> owner: ? -> eta: 14d

sam: i9ll take scheduler policy. will prototype a change, run a staging canary, and capture perf deltas.

maya: i'll own the quota backstop. plan: terraform change + controller webhook that reverts after 72h unless approved. compliance wants audit logs.

li: headroom alerting looks infra heavy. happy to own detection (metric + simple predictor). pat + eng-sre can co-own mitigation (scaling rules + playbook additions).

alex: assigning provisional owners now: scheduler=sam, quota=maya, headroom-detect=li, headroom-mitigate=pat+eng-sre, burst-cap=alex, sampler=sam. i'll update the lane doc.

pat: i added a short checklist in the capacity playbook with escalation contacts and rollback knobs. link: https://git.internal/redwood/playbooks/capacity (see "surge controls")

ops-bot: deploybot: canary scheduled: sam/scheduler-proto -> staging at 2026-04-09T14:00Z

sam: ack, will run canary and post metrics. rollback if p50 latency >5% or error rate uptick.

maya: quota plan detail: 1) soft bump 30% via admin console (manual) 2) controller to auto-revert after 72h 3) alert + finance ticket if consumed. estimate 3d dev + 1d test.

alex: add KMS audit events as part of the change. also include a finance dashboard widget for visibility.

li: recurring pattern note: saw 3 similar surges in 6 weeks: long-context generations that also request embeddings pre-processing. propose sampler that tags requests with >6000 tokens and routes them to a lower-priority pool for isolation.

sam: routing by request shape is doable. i'll run a 48h sampling job (lightweight) to measure impact and list percent of total tokens and request counts. if <1% we can use throttling; if >8% we should consider a dedicated pool.

alex: finalized action list for the lane (owners + due dates):
- sam: scheduler canary + perf report -> due 2755630000
- maya: quota backstop + terraform -> due 2755590000
- li: headroom detection prototype -> due 2755730000
- pat: headroom mitigation policy + playbook update -> due 2755830000
- alex: burst node cap rollout plan -> due 2755615000
- sam: request-shape sampler results -> due 2755690000

pat: will PR playbook checklist today, include on-call escalation tree.

maya: once quota change is live i'll add the finance tile and a short howto for approvals.

sam: propose weekly 15-min check-in on progress. wed 10:00 PT works?

alex: scheduling recurring 15-min sync starting next wed, invite sent.

li: also opening a PR to add a "request-shape heatmap" section to the postmortem template so recurring fingerprints show up automatically.

alex: perfect. i'll publish the lane doc after this thread and tag owners. if anyone needs different due dates reply here. changelog will live in the lane doc + playbook PRs. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all.

sam: will post canary metrics by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: reminder: lane check-in recurring event 2026-04-15T17:00Z

alex: closing thread for now 12 reopen if blockers appear.
